answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 6025 Country: BH Title: Kindly advise details about permissibility of wearing heir piece. My name is Asim. I am 35 years old. I lost my hair 6 years back. I am wearing a hair piece; a temporary attachment like a cap. i take it off when I take bath and perform Abulotion / wadu. I wear it while going out and take it off while in home. Need your assistance. Question: Assalam o Alay Kum Kindly advise details about permissibility of wearing heir piece. My name is Asim. I am 35 years old. I lost my hair 6 years back. I am wearing a hair piece; a temporary attachment like a cap. i take it off when I take bath and perform Abulotion / wadu. I wear it while going out and take it off while in home. Need your assistance. Answer ID: 6025 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 724/678=L/1429) It is allowable to wear a hairpiece when needed if it is not made of human hair, but if it is made of human hair then it shall not be lawful to use it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
